emailBody: The fundraising memo is now close. Project Pure is oversubscribed. Project Care is under LOI.

attachments.name: BEP Core Fund VIII.pdf
attachments.text: BEP Core Fund VIII is a private equity fund. The target fund size is $350MM. The minimum LP commitment is $5MM. The fund has $94.5MM committed across six investments. The deck says Active fundraising and open for new commitments. The portfolio includes a $15.0MM investment in Alpha Services, a $7.5MM investment in Beta Industrial, and a $22.0MM investment in Gamma Business Services. The fund term is 10 years with two one-year extensions. Management fee is 1.75%. Performance fee/carry is 17.5% carried interest above an 8% preferred return. Upcoming investments.

attachments.name: Project Pure Co-Investment.pdf
attachments.text: Project Pure is a specialty ingredients co-investment. Revenue is $240M and adjusted EBITDA is $42M. Total co-investment availability is $80M-$105M. The deck describes allocations as open.

attachments.name: Project Care Co-Investment.pdf
attachments.text: Project Care is an adult day health and HCBS co-investment. The business operates 54 centers serving 8,000 members. Total co-investment availability is approximately $150M-$165M. The deck describes the transaction as in diligence.
